interfaces.name: Root air drying
interfaces.function: Assemble a reusable stone-and-bark tray, process actual roots and allow weather-dependent drying with reversible preservation while sufficiently dry.
interfaces.costs: Build: two stone units and one bark, two rounds at one energy. Load: up to two original root units, two crushing rounds per raw root at one energy. Already crushed compatible food needs one transfer round, with its prior costs and composition preserved. Unload/dismantle: one round and one energy. Passive weather exchange costs no actor rounds.
interfaces.effects: Food begins at its represented composition or the reviewed 50% root water assumption. Uncovered dry weather at 10–40 C removes at most 0.005 water mass per root per round to fraction 0.12; rain returns up to 0.01 per root, capped at original water. At fraction <=0.12 decay is 0.35 baseline, otherwise crushed food is 1.25 baseline. Exposure continues after unloading. No lost nutrients, reverse spoilage, sterilization or free materials.

execution.progress: Exact processId, actual site, escrow, reusable tools, paid energy and remaining work. Continue resumes; changing actions or lost reach pauses. Cancel/death releases actual material once without effort refunds.

interfaces.name: Assess and peel actual branch bark
interfaces.function: Assess actual materials and separate a finite branch outer layer using a personally inspected reusable stone or flint contact.
interfaces.costs: Assess: one round and 0.2 energy. Peel: two active work-round equivalents and two energy per original branch unit, proportionally less for fractional or partly peeled inputs; one final partial simulation round pays only remaining effort. Reserve actual source and one reusable inspected hard stone/flint. No hard inventory capacity exists; actual load costs continue.
interfaces.effects: Standing trunks without represented tissue remain ineligible. Unspecified intact branch partitions at most 10% of existing mass into outer bark. Exact-tenth bark units round down; sub-unit mass stays bark-fines. Peeled core cannot satisfy intact-branch recipes. Existing composition, nutrients, toxins, fuel and age persist. Cancellation/death releases actual partial materials once. Assessment alone has no reward; a new verified paid separation can use existing grounded understanding.

execution.progress: Exact personal processId, paid and remaining effort, reserved tool, actual separated mass and residual layer. Reissue peel with processId to resume. Other actions pause; cancel/death terminates without refund.
